The main takeaway from our work is that

there is a need to develop a better understanding of the role of brain temperature and pyrexia in patients with traumatic brain injury and to establish whether there is a role for body temperature control in patients with traumatic head injury.

the use of hypotothermia in the treatment of TBI is not supported by robust scientific evidence, and that there is a need for randomized trials to establish whether cooling patients with TBI to normothermia or moderate pyrexia is associated with better outcomes than the use of hypohybermia.
